programs.title: Secrets of the Underground
programs.sub_title: The mystery of the Neapolitan volcano
programs.desc: Scientist and new technology fanatic Rob Nelson and co-presenter of the programs, geophysicist Stefan Burns will try to discover the greatest secrets of archeology and architecture.They will visit unusual and most often forgotten caves, sewers and chemical laboratories.Viewers will see dark matter detectors and places where lost civilizations once existed.Innovative radars and 3D imaging technology will allow you to recreate the appearance of mysterious undergrounds and reach these dark, hidden, unknown places.Rob and Stefan will thoroughly analyze famous legends, for example the one about a Nazi train full of gold hidden in Poland, or about the lost temple in Jerusalem.
